# pai antipatterns

Anti-patterns: status, firings, candidates, retirement

```
pai antipatterns <command>
```

The anti-pattern directory (shipped antipatterns/<category>/<id>.yaml plus your own under PAI_HOME/antipatterns). Every guard firing is recorded; these commands show which patterns fire, on which model and with what outcome, promote new cases caught by guards, and switch patterns between enforce and monitor or retire them. Shipped files are never edited: a change writes a user override file with the same id.

```sh
pai antipatterns list --status stable
pai antipatterns stats --since 7d
pai antipatterns candidates
```

See also: `pai rules list`

### pai antipatterns list

Every pattern with status, mode and version

```
pai antipatterns list [options]
```

Shell rules and every other category. Filter with --category and --status (experimental, test, stable, deprecated).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--category NAME` | string | — | shell, tool-loop, final-text or paths |
| `--status STATUS` | string | — | experimental, test, stable or deprecated |
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai antipatterns list --category tool-loop
```

### pai antipatterns stats

Firing counts, models, outcomes and health flags per pattern

```
pai antipatterns stats [options]
```

Per pattern: firings, last fired, firings per model, actions, outcome mix, false-positive rate (fp/(tp+fp) over labelled firings), override rate. Flags: false-positive suspect (a deny or stop followed by a successful run, except in the paths category where that is the rule working, or a monitor hit with no bad outcome), model-quirk (over 90% of at least 5 firings on one model), retire candidate (no firing in 30 days, or false-positive rate over 50% across at least 10 labelled firings).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--since AGE` | string | — | Only firings newer than this, e.g. 12h, 7d, 2w |
| `--model ID` | string | — | Only firings on this model |
| `--source hook|proxy` | string | — | Only firings decided by the hooks or by the model-API proxy |
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai antipatterns stats --since 7d
pai antipatterns stats --model glm-5
pai antipatterns stats --source proxy
```

### pai antipatterns candidates

Cases a guard stopped that no pattern covers

```
pai antipatterns candidates [options]
```

Inactive files under PAI_HOME/antipatterns/_candidates. Review, then `pai antipatterns promote ID`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai antipatterns candidates
```

### pai antipatterns promote

Make a candidate a pattern (status test, mode monitor)

```
pai antipatterns promote ID
```

Moves the candidate into PAI_HOME/antipatterns/<category>/. It starts in monitor mode: it records, it does not act.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Pattern id (see: pai antipatterns list) |

```sh
pai antipatterns promote cand-1a2b3c4d
```

### pai antipatterns enforce

Switch a pattern to enforce mode

```
pai antipatterns enforce ID
```

Writes a user override with mode: enforce.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Pattern id (see: pai antipatterns list) |

```sh
pai antipatterns enforce repeated-failure
```

### pai antipatterns monitor

Switch a pattern to monitor mode (record, take no action)

```
pai antipatterns monitor ID
```

Writes a user override with mode: monitor.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Pattern id (see: pai antipatterns list) |

```sh
pai antipatterns monitor git-reset-hard
```

### pai antipatterns retire

Retire a pattern (status deprecated)

```
pai antipatterns retire ID [options]
```

Writes a user override with status: deprecated; a deprecated pattern does nothing. Shipped files are never deleted.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Pattern id (see: pai antipatterns list) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--reason TEXT` | string | — | Why it is retired |

```sh
pai antipatterns retire revert --reason 'never fired in 60 days'
```

### pai antipatterns set

Change one detector parameter of a pattern

```
pai antipatterns set ID PARAM VALUE [options]
```

Writes the user override (a full copy of the active file on first use), sets detector.params.PARAM to VALUE (numbers and booleans are parsed), bumps version, sets modified and appends to the file's changes list and to antipatterns/governance.jsonl. With --model the value goes to per_model.<model>.params.PARAM and applies only to that model; without it the global param changes. Unknown params and type mismatches are refused. Takes effect without a restart.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Pattern id (see: pai antipatterns list) |
| `PARAM` | yes | Detector parameter, e.g. stop_at |
| `VALUE` | yes | New value |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--reason TEXT` | string | — | Why (required) |
| `--model ID` | string | — | Scope the change to this model (per_model entry) instead of the global param |

```sh
pai antipatterns set identical-write stop_at 8 --reason 'loops cost too much'
pai antipatterns set identical-write stop_at 8 --model qwen3.8-flash-next-gyro-m --reason 'fired 11x on gyro-m'
```

### pai antipatterns label

Label a firing (or all firings of a pattern) tp, fp or benign_tp

```
pai antipatterns label TARGET DISPOSITION
```

TARGET is a firing's ts (from firings.jsonl) or a pattern id. Labels feed the false-positive rate in stats.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TARGET` | yes | Firing ts or pattern id |
| `DISPOSITION` | yes | tp | fp | benign_tp |

```sh
pai antipatterns label git-reset-hard fp
```

### pai antipatterns conflicts

Duplicate ids and patterns that match each other's fixtures with different actions

```
pai antipatterns conflicts [options]
```

Exit 1 when there is a conflict.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai antipatterns conflicts
```
